# Veyrnox.ai

> Veyrnox.ai is a credit-metered AI generation service for video, image and audio. One credit balance works across every model. Each generation shows its price before you press Generate, and a failed generation is refunded automatically. Operated by Veyrnox Ltd, London, UK.

Prices are not listed in this file because they change. The live price of every model is on the Models and Pricing pages below.

## Start here

- [Models](https://veyrnox.ai/models): every model with its exact price in credits, and a page for each one.
- [Pricing](https://veyrnox.ai/pricing): credit packs, subscription plans and the full model price table.
- [Tools](https://veyrnox.ai/tools): models that start from your own image, video or audio file (upscale, cut out, expand, edit, animate, lip-sync).
- [Templates](https://veyrnox.ai/presets): ready-made prompt, model and aspect ratio in one click.
- [About](https://veyrnox.ai/about): who runs the service.

## For developers and agents

- [Developers](https://veyrnox.ai/developers): API access and documentation.
- [OpenAPI contract](https://veyrnox.ai/api/developer/openapi): read-only machine-readable description of the developer API.
- [MCP server](https://veyrnox.ai/mcp): connect an AI assistant to generate through Veyrnox.ai.
